name: restart-service
description: Restart a named local service. APPROVAL REQUIRED before restart.
preconditions: service is a known local service
steps: STOP: confirm the exact service name with the user
check dependents that would be interrupted and warn
restart only after approval, then verify it came back healthy
failure_recovery: report startup logs tail and suggest the manual command
cautions: APPROVAL REQUIRED: never restart without explicit confirmation
named services only: never restart by pattern, pid, or wildcard
never restart remote, production, or unknown services
